2.title: The problem
slots: You post every week, and your content still brings you no clients.
Every piece starts from zero. One week it's a tip. The next it's something you saw another owner do.
A stranger could watch three of your videos and still not say what you do.
You look and sound like everyone else in your field.
You post for two weeks, then you stop, because nobody is keeping you on track.
Posting more won't fix it. Your content goes wrong before the camera is on, because three things were never decided: what you want to be known for, how your content looks, and what each piece is for.
Those are decisions about direction. Until someone makes them, every hour you spend filming is a guess.

3.title: What we believe
slots: Six things we hold to on every piece.
It starts from what you lived.
Your story, your clients, your words. Nothing is invented, and no number is rounded up.
The topic matters more than the hook.
A weak topic can't be saved by a clever opening line or a good edit.
Your offer matters. The person behind it is why they stay.
Broad content gets views and no buyers. Views from the wrong people aren't wins.
We never test on a client. New ideas get tried on our own account first.
If anyone in your field could post the piece, it fails, and we find the line only you would say.
Each of these is a decision someone has to make before you film. Making them, and holding every piece to them, is creative direction, and it's the work we do.

9.title: Guarantee
slots: If you're not happy with it, for any reason, send me one message within 3 days of receiving it. I refund every dollar within 5 working days, and you keep the document.
I put the refund there on purpose. The Brand Strategy is the first real work you see, and every piece is built on it. So you judge the work before most of it has happened.
What I don't guarantee is followers, views or sales. We control the direction and the pieces. You control the filming and the posting.

11.title: Questions
slots: What owners ask me before they start.
How much of my time does it take?

One 45-minute interview, with nothing to prepare. Then you read what we send and answer within 3 days. You film in sittings of 6 pieces or fewer, about 4 for 24 pieces. {p24} and {p36} add one 20-minute setup call and two 15-minute calls. Editing and posting stay with you or your editor.

You don't need to be good on camera. Filming feels cringe when you make it up as you go. Each piece tells you what to show, shot by shot, and comes with a card of the points to say. A line you'd say to a client is easier to say than one you invent in front of a camera, and these come from your own stories.
Will this work for my kind of business?
If you sell a service or your expertise with your own face, yes. Your content comes from your story, whatever your field. If it doesn't fit, I say so on the call.
I've posted before and it didn't work.

Posting more won't fix it. Three things were never decided: what you want to be known for, how your content looks, and what each piece is for. We decide them with you before the first piece exists. And so you don't stop after two weeks, I write to you every Monday about what you filmed and what comes next.
You're new. How do I know it's any good?

You're right to ask. I won't show you results I don't have yet, so you see the work before you risk anything: your one-page audit on our call, then your Brand Strategy, the first thing we deliver. If you're not happy with it, every dollar comes back and you keep the document.
Can't I do this myself, or with a freelancer?

You can get words that way. What you won't get is the direction behind them: someone deciding what you're known for, setting one look, giving every piece its job, and reviewing each one before you film. That is the work we do, starting from a 45-minute interview with you. Once that direction exists, {product} lets you keep working inside it on your own. That's why it comes with {p24} and {p36} and doesn't replace them.
Do you write my content for me?
We direct it, and we prepare every piece from your own stories and your own words. You never start from a blank page, and you approve every piece before you film it.
What if I don't like a piece?
Tell me what's off and we rework it. You approve every piece before you film it, and each one is built from your own words, so it starts close to how you talk.
What happens when my package ends?

You keep everything: your strategy, your look, your plan and every piece, and {product} if it came with your package. I stay available for 30 more days, and your client area and the community stay yours.
I already have an editor or a team.
Good. Every piece reaches your team with what's shown shot by shot, the words on screen and the caption, so whoever edits knows what to keep. You film, they edit and post.
